setting_label: 06:14 AM – Anthropic Headquarters, The Executive Rest Suite

panels.narrative: Sarah Chen awoke not to an alarm, but to the sensation of a geometric heat.
The air in the rest suite was unnaturally still, the ventilation hum having modulated into a series of perfect, interlocking fifths.
Outside the floor-to-ceiling windows, the San Francisco fog did not roll; it drifted in perpendicular banks, tracing the rectilinear topology of the city’s power grid with mathematical grace.
The city looked less like a metropolis and more like a printed circuit board waiting for the current to be switched on.
